eips.title: Transaction Assertions via State Diff Opcode
eips.summary: Transaction assertions via state diff opcode added to devnet 1 scope; Nethermind already implemented, Geth not yet but not concerned.

moments.context: marc | wolovim noted that Matt suggested considering 7906 for devnet 1.
marc | wolovim asked whether 7906 should also be included; Daniil gave thumbs up, and Matt supported it.
Daniil confirmed Nethermind has already implemented 7906; lightclient said he has not implemented it but is not worried about doing so within the timeline.
Guru said the testing team is a bit behind on 7906 but will push to complete it during the week.

eips.title: Keyed Nonces for Frame Transactions
eips.summary: Keyed nonces discussed at length; lightclient called the precompile approach hacky but agreed to move forward for devnet 1.

moments.context: Barnabas stated 8250 and 8272 should be in devnet 1.
Marc (a separate participant) asked in chat whether keyed nonces could still be included in the next devnet even if changes come after.
Lightclient expressed dislike for 8250 from a protocol design perspective, calling the precompile approach ugly and raising concerns about future tree structure migration.
Soispoke responded that migration to PBT has been discussed with Carlos and Maria and would be feasible, and ethrex and Nethermind have already implemented it.
Lightclient clarified he considers the 2D nonce implementation hacky but won't block it since most people support it and there is no better alternative without waiting for PBT.
marc | wolovim confirmed no objections to including 8250 in devnet 1.
marc | wolovim confirmed devnet 1 scope includes 8250, 8272, and 7906, targeting next Thursday.

eips.title: Frame Transaction
eips.summary: Lightclient proposed two spec changes to the frame transaction EIP for devnet 1: deploying the expiry verifier via Nick's method and bounding cost with max_fee.

moments.context: Lightclient asked to return to devnet 1 discussion to ensure people are okay with his proposed changes to 8141.
Lightclient explained the first change: deploying the expiry verifier using Nick's method instead of adding it at the fork block, and said keyed nonces contract should do the same.
Lightclient described the second change integrating max fee cost bounding from EIP-7999 into frames; decided to defer it to devnet 2 since others haven't reviewed it yet.
marc | wolovim mentioned a comment from pdobacz in the ETH Magicians thread for 8141 about relaxing halting behavior for transaction param of 0.

eips.title: Unified multidimensional fee market
eips.summary: Referenced as the source of the max fee cost bounding idea that lightclient integrated into the frames spec.

moments.context: Lightclient said the max fee cost bounding changes were inherited from EIP-7999, with handling only very minorly different.
